title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
summary: Find the smallest value in a sorted array of distinct numbers that has been rotated by an unknown amount.

tests.explain: The array drops from 7 to 0, so the minimum is 0.
Rotated by 3: the second run starts at 1.
Rotating by 0 (or by a full lap) leaves the array sorted, so the minimum is the first element.

hints: A rotated sorted array is two sorted runs glued together. The minimum is the first element of the second run, the one place where the array drops.
Compare nums[mid] with nums[right]. If nums[mid] > nums[right], the drop must be to the right of mid, so the minimum is in (mid, right]. Otherwise the minimum is at mid or to its left.
Loop while left < right with mid = (left + right) >> 1. Set left = mid + 1 when nums[mid] > nums[right], else right = mid (not mid - 1: mid itself could be the answer). Return nums[left].

complexity.time: O(log n): the search range halves each step
